subject.title: docs(skills): add backporting to release maintainer

question: Should release-openclaw-maintainer own extended-stable backport discovery and npm-only publication after the plugin selector repair wording is corrected?
rationale: The remaining code-review defect is mechanically fixable, but accepting the integrated backport, publication, and private-advisory workflow is a release/security ownership decision.

options.title: Keep integrated release skill
options.body: Fix the plugin selector repair wording, then let the existing release-maintainer skill own backport discovery, staging, and publication handoff.

options.title: Split backporting back out
options.body: Keep extended-stable backport discovery in a separate skill if maintainers want it operationally distinct from general release publishing.

options.title: Pause until policy settles
options.body: Leave the PR draft while the extended-stable repair and advisory workflow is refined outside this branch.

recommendation.title: Keep integrated release skill
recommendation.body: Fix the plugin selector repair wording, then let the existing release-maintainer skill own backport discovery, staging, and publication handoff.
